title: Appoint a member of a limited liability partnership (LL AP01)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House about an individual being appointed as a member of an LLP.

 Before you file

 All LLP members must verify their identity to prove who they are. You’ll need to give their Companies House personal code and confirm they have verified their identity.

 See  Verifying your identity for Companies House .

 How to file

 File online to update your information as quickly as possible.

 It takes longer to process paper forms sent to us by post.

 Do not use the paper form if your LLP is in the protected online filing (PROOF) scheme .

 Chrome users may not be able to view checkboxes on printed versions of this form. You can use a different browser or file this document online.

 Forms need to be printed at full size on white A4 sized paper.
